mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificates are verified on all builds, development builds included, with no exemption for development. This is reinforced by the recorded rule of HTTPS everywhere with no plaintext exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
